description: Use this when a person asks where The Wellness is, or which cities it serves. Returns every city, London, Dubai, Beverly Hills, New York, Miami, Singapore, Hong Kong, Paris, Monaco, San Francisco, Tokyo, Sydney, Milan, Riyadh and Jeddah, with its country, currency, whether it is booked online or by request, whether it is open now and its hours. London is booked and paid online. In every other city the team confirms a request within the hour.
name: list_cities
title: List the cities
